name: nodd Consent
author: debayansen

sections.description:
nodd helps small businesses meet DPDP obligations: an itemised privacy notice, a consent banner and a record of every choice.

This plugin connects a WordPress or WooCommerce site to nodd:

  • Adds the nodd consent banner to every page, before any tracker loads.
  • Holds back Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity and similar tags until the visitor agrees, and sends Google Consent Mode v2 signals.
  • Points the site’s privacy policy link (footer, registration, checkout privacy text) to your nodd Privacy Center.
  • [nodd_privacy_settings] shortcode for a link that lets visitors change their choice.

This plugin is software, not legal advice.

External services

This plugin is the WordPress side of the nodd service and does nothing until you enter a site key from your nodd account.

  • On every front-end page, visitors’ browsers load the banner script (/w.js) and its settings (business name and notice version) from your nodd address (default https://nodd.in). When a visitor makes a choice, the banner sends nodd a random visitor id, the notice version and the choices made. No name, email or IP address is stored by nodd.
  • On the plugin’s settings page, your server requests the same settings once to show whether the site key is connected. Only the site key is sent.

nodd terms: https://nodd.in/terms
nodd privacy policy: https://nodd.in/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Publish your privacy notice in the nodd console.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > nodd, enter your site key from the console’s Consent page, and save.
sections.faq:
Do I need a nodd account?

Yes. The banner shows your published privacy notice and records choices in your nodd console. Sign up free at https://nodd.in.

Which trackers are held back?

Google Analytics and Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn, TikTok, Hotjar and Microsoft Clarity scripts added through WordPress. Trackers pasted as raw HTML need type="text/plain" data-nodd="analytics" (or marketing) added by hand.

Is this legal advice?

No. nodd is software. Review your notice with your own legal advisor.
